justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/jarscan/invokecount/InvokeCountOperation.java, MethodCountMap.java, InvokeMethodCountMap.java, and core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/jarscan/JarScan.java. The target package contains only these 3 classes and has only one in-repo incoming dependency: JarScan creates InvokeCountOperation in its invokecount CLI branch. Its outgoing dependencies are limited to shared infrastructure types (IJarScanOperation, model.bytecode classes, ParseUtil, and JITWatchConstants), which are used broadly elsewhere in the repository. That evidence does not show a stable package depending on less stable packages, so UD is not present.
